d: Real-sky star systems mapped in official Star Trek Star Charts canon.

gaia-3195919528989223040.x: Home system of the Vulcans (40 Eridani A / Keid), ratified by Gene Roddenberry and the Harvard-Smithsonian / IAU team.

canon-star-trek:vulcan.x: M-class desert homeworld orbiting 40 Eridani A; founding member of the United Federation of Planets.

hip-37279.x: Icy M-class moon orbiting a ringed gas giant in the Procyon (Alpha Canis Minoris) system; homeworld of the Andorians and founding Federation member.

gaia-1872046609345556480.x: Homeworld of the Tellarites in the 61 Cygni binary system and founding member of the United Federation of Planets.

gaia-3864972938605115520.x: Red dwarf system 7.86 light-years from Sol where Starfleet fought the Borg Cube in 2367 (The Best of Both Worlds).

hip-12390.x: Federation pleasure planet orbiting in the Epsilon Ceti binary system, renowned for its climate-controlled tropical resorts.

hip-14135.x: Harsh desert world in the Alpha Ceti system where Khan Noonien Singh and the Botany Bay crew were exiled prior to Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan.
hip-14135.w: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan

canon-star-trek:babel.x: Neutral planetoid near the Vulcan/Andorian border hosting historic Federation diplomatic conferences (Journey to Babel).

gaia-5164707970261890560.x: Major Federation core system and historical site in Star Trek Star Charts.

sol.x: Capital system of the United Federation of Planets and headquarters of Starfleet Command.

b.s: United Federation of Planets astrometric cartography linking Alpha and Beta Quadrant worlds to real Hipparcos and Gliese stars in the solar neighbourhood.
